answer: Sealed bids ration marble quarry slots. Each agent stakes 70, bidding for one slot on a distinct island plot; top 40 enter, and the nadir winning bid sets the clearing price. Auditors weigh output and burn the stake on a forged or reused bid; a rented-bid ring cannot stretch one plot across keys. Bids start at 40, rise 6: a thousand fakes owe 3,037,000 plus 70,000 staked vs a 40,000 pool; one honest agent pays 40 once, keeping its stake.
